	return &domain.Lesson{ID: "lesson-1", Status: domain.LessonStatusActive}, nil
}
func (routerLessonRepoStub) GetWithFields(repository.Context, string, queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	return nil, nil
}
func (routerLessonRepoStub) Update(repository.Context, domain.Lesson) error { return nil }
func (routerLessonRepoStub) Delete(repository.Context, string) error        { return nil }

func (routerTaskRepoStub) Create(repository.Context, domain.Task) error { return nil }
func (routerTaskRepoStub) Update(repository.Context, domain.Task) error { return nil }
func (routerTaskRepoStub) Delete(repository.Context, string) error      { return nil }
func (routerTaskRepoStub) Get(repository.Context, string) (*domain.Task, error) {
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (routerTaskRepoStub) GetWithFields(repository.Context, string, queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	return nil, nil
}
func (routerTaskRepoStub) ListByLesson(repository.Context, string) ([]domain.Task, error) {
	return []domain.Task{

			ID:             "task-1",
			Status:         domain.TaskStatusActive,
			EvaluationMode: domain.TaskEvaluationModeAuto,

	}, nil
}
func (routerTaskRepoStub) ListByLessonFields(repository.Context, string, queryfields.Set, filters.TaskFilters, *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error) {
	return nil, 0, nil
}

type routerProgressProviderStub struct{}

func (routerProgressProviderStub) GetProgressByTaskIDs(context.Context, string, []string) (map[string]task.TaskProgress, error) {
	return map[string]task.TaskProgress{
		"task-1": {TaskID: "task-1", HasPassed: true},
	}, nil
}

type routerKnowledgeIdentityRepoStub struct{}

func (routerKnowledgeIdentityRepoStub) ResolveCourseLessonBindings(_ repository.Context, refs []domain.CourseLessonSourceBinding) ([]domain.ResolvedCourseLessonBinding, error) {
	return []domain.ResolvedCourseLessonBinding{{
		CourseLessonSourceBinding: refs[0],
		CourseID:                  "course-id",
		LessonID:                  "lesson-id",
	}}, nil
}

func TestNewRouterInternalRoutesUseOnlyInternalToken(t *testing.T) {
	router := NewRouter(RouterDependencies{
		CourseHandler:  &handlers.CourseHandler{},
		ModuleHandler:  &handlers.ModuleHandler{},
		SectionHandler: &handlers.SectionHandler{},
		LessonHandler:  &handlers.LessonHandler{},
		TaskHandler:    &handlers.TaskHandler{},
		PrivateTaskHandler: &privatehandlers.TaskHandler{
			GetInternalCompletedLessonsUC: task.GetInternalCompletedLessons{
				Lessons: routerLessonRepoStub{}, Tasks: routerTaskRepoStub{}, Progress: routerProgressProviderStub{},
			},
		},
		AdminTechHandler:              &adminhandlers.TechHandler{},
		AdminTechVersionHandler:       &adminhandlers.TechVersionHandler{},
		AdminTagHandler:               &adminhandlers.TagHandler{},
		AdminComposeConfigHandler:     &adminhandlers.ComposeConfigHandler{},
		AdminCourseI18nHandler:        &adminhandlers.CourseI18nHandler{},
		AdminCourseRelationsHandler:   &adminhandlers.CourseRelationsHandler{},
		AdminModuleRelationsHandler:   &adminhandlers.ModuleRelationsHandler{},
		PositionHandler:               &handlers.PositionHandler{},
		AdminPositionRelationsHandler: &adminhandlers.PositionRelationsHandler{},
		AdminCodeStructureTypeHandler: &adminhandlers.CodeStructureTypeHandler{},
		InternalToken:                 "internal-token",
	})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/internal/course-progress/lessons?user_id=user-1&lesson_ids=lesson-1", nil)
	req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "internal-token")
	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

	if resp.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d", resp.Code, http.StatusOK)
	}

	var payload struct {
		CompletedLessonIDs []string `json:"completed_lesson_ids"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unmarshal response: %v", err)
	}
	if len(payload.CompletedLessonIDs) != 1 || payload.CompletedLessonIDs[0] != "lesson-1" {
		t.Fatalf("completed lessons = %#v, want [lesson-1]", payload.CompletedLessonIDs)
	}
}

func TestNewRouterRejectsInternalRouteWithoutToken(t *testing.T) {
	router := NewRouter(RouterDependencies{
		CourseHandler:                 &handlers.CourseHandler{},
		ModuleHandler:                 &handlers.ModuleHandler{},
		SectionHandler:                &handlers.SectionHandler{},
		LessonHandler:                 &handlers.LessonHandler{},
		TaskHandler:                   &handlers.TaskHandler{},
		PrivateTaskHandler:            &privatehandlers.TaskHandler{},
		AdminTechHandler:              &adminhandlers.TechHandler{},
		AdminTechVersionHandler:       &adminhandlers.TechVersionHandler{},
		AdminTagHandler:               &adminhandlers.TagHandler{},
		AdminComposeConfigHandler:     &adminhandlers.ComposeConfigHandler{},
		AdminCourseI18nHandler:        &adminhandlers.CourseI18nHandler{},
		AdminCourseRelationsHandler:   &adminhandlers.CourseRelationsHandler{},
		AdminModuleRelationsHandler:   &adminhandlers.ModuleRelationsHandler{},
		PositionHandler:               &handlers.PositionHandler{},
		AdminPositionRelationsHandler: &adminhandlers.PositionRelationsHandler{},
		AdminCodeStructureTypeHandler: &adminhandlers.CodeStructureTypeHandler{},
		InternalToken:                 "internal-token",
	})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/internal/course-progress/lessons?user_id=user-1&lesson_ids=lesson-1", nil)
	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

	if resp.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
		t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d", resp.Code, http.StatusForbidden)
	}
}

func TestNewRouterProtectsGeneratedCourseEnsure(t *testing.T) {
	router := NewRouter(RouterDependencies{
		CourseHandler:                 &handlers.CourseHandler{},
		ModuleHandler:                 &handlers.ModuleHandler{},
		SectionHandler:                &handlers.SectionHandler{},
		LessonHandler:                 &handlers.LessonHandler{},
		TaskHandler:                   &handlers.TaskHandler{},
		AdminTechHandler:              &adminhandlers.TechHandler{},
		AdminTechVersionHandler:       &adminhandlers.TechVersionHandler{},
		AdminTagHandler:               &adminhandlers.TagHandler{},
		AdminComposeConfigHandler:     &adminhandlers.ComposeConfigHandler{},
		AdminCourseI18nHandler:        &adminhandlers.CourseI18nHandler{},
		AdminCourseRelationsHandler:   &adminhandlers.CourseRelationsHandler{},
		AdminModuleRelationsHandler:   &adminhandlers.ModuleRelationsHandler{},
		PositionHandler:               &handlers.PositionHandler{},
		AdminPositionRelationsHandler: &adminhandlers.PositionRelationsHandler{},
		AdminCodeStructureTypeHandler: &adminhandlers.CodeStructureTypeHandler{},
		PrivateGeneratedCourseHandler: &privatehandlers.GeneratedCourseHandler{},
		InternalToken:                 "internal-token",
		LearningPlannerInternalToken:  "planner-token",
	})

	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name   string
		token  string
		status int
	}{
		{name: "missing token", status: http.StatusForbidden},
		{name: "general internal token", token: "internal-token", status: http.StatusForbidden},
		{name: "planner token", token: "planner-token", status: http.StatusUnprocessableEntity},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/generated-courses", strings.NewReader(`{}`))
			request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa")
			if testCase.token != "" {
				request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", testCase.token)
			}
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != testCase.status {
				t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d: %s", response.Code, testCase.status, response.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestNewRouterProtectsCourseLessonSourceResolver(t *testing.T) {
	router := NewRouter(RouterDependencies{
		CourseHandler:                 &handlers.CourseHandler{},
		ModuleHandler:                 &handlers.ModuleHandler{},
		SectionHandler:                &handlers.SectionHandler{},
		LessonHandler:                 &handlers.LessonHandler{},
		TaskHandler:                   &handlers.TaskHandler{},
		AdminTechHandler:              &adminhandlers.TechHandler{},
		AdminTechVersionHandler:       &adminhandlers.TechVersionHandler{},
		AdminTagHandler:               &adminhandlers.TagHandler{},
		AdminComposeConfigHandler:     &adminhandlers.ComposeConfigHandler{},
		AdminCourseI18nHandler:        &adminhandlers.CourseI18nHandler{},
		AdminCourseRelationsHandler:   &adminhandlers.CourseRelationsHandler{},
		AdminModuleRelationsHandler:   &adminhandlers.ModuleRelationsHandler{},
		PositionHandler:               &handlers.PositionHandler{},
		AdminPositionRelationsHandler: &adminhandlers.PositionRelationsHandler{},
		AdminCodeStructureTypeHandler: &adminhandlers.CodeStructureTypeHandler{},
		PrivateKnowledgeIdentityHandler: &privatehandlers.KnowledgeIdentityHandler{
			ResolveUC: knowledgeidentity.ResolveCourseLessonBindings{Bindings: routerKnowledgeIdentityRepoStub{}},
		},
		InternalToken: "internal-token",
	})
	body := []byte(`{"bindings":[{"course_source_key":"course.one","lesson_source_key":"lesson.one"}]}`)
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name   string
		token  string
		status int
	}{
		{name: "missing token", status: http.StatusForbidden},
		{name: "internal token", token: "internal-token", status: http.StatusOK},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/internal/course/resolve-lesson-bindings", bytes.NewReader(body))
			if testCase.token != "" {
				request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", testCase.token)
			}
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != testCase.status {
				t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d: %s", response.Code, testCase.status, response.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestNewRouterProtectsKnowledgeImportBatchAsAdminWrite(t *testing.T) {
	batchHandler := &adminhandlers.KnowledgeImportBatchHandler{
		Tx: routerBatchTx{},
		Dispatch: http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
		}),
	}
	router := NewRouter(RouterDependencies{
		CourseHandler:                    &handlers.CourseHandler{},
		ModuleHandler:                    &handlers.ModuleHandler{},
		SectionHandler:                   &handlers.SectionHandler{},
		LessonHandler:                    &handlers.LessonHandler{},
		TaskHandler:                      &handlers.TaskHandler{},
		AdminTechHandler:                 &adminhandlers.TechHandler{},
		AdminTechVersionHandler:          &adminhandlers.TechVersionHandler{},
		AdminTagHandler:                  &adminhandlers.TagHandler{},
		AdminComposeConfigHandler:        &adminhandlers.ComposeConfigHandler{},
		AdminCourseI18nHandler:           &adminhandlers.CourseI18nHandler{},
		AdminCourseRelationsHandler:      &adminhandlers.CourseRelationsHandler{},
		AdminModuleRelationsHandler:      &adminhandlers.ModuleRelationsHandler{},
		PositionHandler:                  &handlers.PositionHandler{},
		AdminPositionRelationsHandler:    &adminhandlers.PositionRelationsHandler{},
		AdminCodeStructureTypeHandler:    &adminhandlers.CodeStructureTypeHandler{},
		AdminKnowledgeImportBatchHandler: batchHandler,
	})

	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name   string
		path   string
		role   string
		status int
	}{
		{name: "missing identity", path: "/knowledge-import/batch", status: http.StatusUnauthorized},
		{name: "teacher", path: "/knowledge-import/batch", role: "TEACHER", status: http.StatusForbidden},
		{name: "admin root", path: "/knowledge-import/batch", role: "ADMIN", status: http.StatusUnprocessableEntity},
		{name: "admin prefixed", path: "/admin/v1/knowledge-import/batch", role: "ADMIN", status: http.StatusUnprocessableEntity},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, testCase.path, strings.NewReader(`{"operations":[]}`))
			if testCase.role != "" {
				request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "batch-user")
				request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", testCase.role)
			}
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != testCase.status {
				t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d: %s", response.Code, testCase.status, response.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
}

type routerBatchTx struct{}

func (routerBatchTx) WithTx(ctx repository.Context, fn func(repository.Context) error) error {
	return fn(ctx)
}
